title: The Hungry Harvest
author: K. M. Zhou
blurb: Ansel Ashgrove, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
